Recommended: Option 1

-   Reasonable return timing:   19:40 departure gives a full final day before heading back.
Why the others are weaker

-   Option 3   — Cheapest, but weaker because it has   1 stop each way  , which directly conflicts with the nonstop preference and adds travel risk/time.
-   Option 4   — Nonstop and within budget, but weaker because the outbound   arrives at 18:50  , which misses the preferred arrival-before-18:00 requirement.
Fit Against Your Priorities
Context used: 1 adult, carry-on only, total budget under €320, nonstop preferred, outbound arrival before 18:00.
-   Priority 1: Budget under €320   — Options 1, 2, 3, and 4 all qualify.
-   Priority 2: Nonstop preferred   — Options 1, 2, and 4 qualify; Option 3 does not.
-   Priority 3: Outbound arrival before 18:00   — Options 1, 2, and 3 qualify; Option 4 does not.
-   Business convenience winner:     Option 1  , because it balances all constraints best without a major trade-off.
